name: Paladin
description: A Paladin is a holy warrior, imbued with divine magic and bound by a sacred oath to pursue justice and righteousness. They wield both weapons and healing powers, serving as a beacon of hope and a bulwark against evil, often leading the charge in battles against darkness.

actions.name: Slash
actions.description: The Paladin makes an attack with their 2-Handed sword, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Lay Hands
actions.description: The Paladin touches a creature an restores their health to half up to a maximum of 30. This action can only be used once per day.

actions.name: Smiting Blade
actions.description: After dealing damage with the Slash action, the Paladin spends 2 power and attempts to smite a creature, dealing divine damage. Dark creatures automatically fail this check.

actions.name: Attack of Opportunity
actions.description: In response to a creature leaving the Paladin's area of control, they make an attack with the Slash action against that target.

actions.name: Pommel Strike
actions.description: After using the Slash action, the Paladin uses the pommel of their sword to make an attack at an adjacent creature, dealing physical damage. The target must make a concentration check against the total damage received after mitigation or become dazed. On a true hit, the target becomes stunned.

actions.name: Dueling Strike
actions.description: The Paladin makes an attack with their sword while also interposing it, dealing physical damage. If the attack hits, the targeted creature has a 1d4 penalty on attack rolls against any creature except the paladin until the end of their turn.

traits.name: Divine Warrior
traits.description: The Paladin gains a 1d4 bonus to attack checks against dark creatures and has a 1d4 bonus to resistance checks against spells and effects from dark creatures.
